why.title: A New Way to Research Trademarks in Afghanistan

before.title: Before You Get Started
before.text: The Help Center is designed to answer common questions and guide you through using TMistan. If you need assistance with a specific issue, please contact our support team.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Common Questions
faq.text: Quick answers to the most frequently asked questions from our users.

help.a1: Enter a keyword in the search box — a trademark name, applicant name, serial number (for example 1011-002), Official Gazette number (for example 1011), class number or a word from the goods and services — and press Search.
help.q2: How do I refine the results?
help.a2: After a search, filters appear above the results: Class, Gazette, Applicant, Application Type, Date Range and Advanced (mark name, serial number, goods and services, fuzzy matching). You can also sort the results and switch between the grid and table views. Use “Clear All” to remove the filters.
help.q3: How do I open a record?
help.a3: Click a result card or a row in the table. The record page shows the trademark name, serial number, applicant, address, class, goods and services, application type, publication date and the trademark image where one is available.
help.q4: What does the source information mean?
help.a4: Every record shows the Official Gazette (OG) number and the page on which it was published, for example “Source: OG 1011 — Page 3”. Information that is not available in the published record is shown as N/A.
help.a5: The serial number identifies a record within a gazette issue — “1011-002” is the second record published in Official Gazette 1011.
help.q6: Why does a record have no image?
help.a6: Images are shown where one is available for the record. Records without an image show “No image on file for this trademark”.
help.a7: “Download Record” on a record page generates a printable PDF of the record — the Trademark Publication Report — with its source reference and disclaimer, and downloads it.
help.q8: Can I report incorrect information in a record?
help.a8: Yes. Open the record and use “Report an issue”, or go to the Data Corrections page and describe what appears to be wrong and which record it concerns. Requests are reviewed against the published source material; submitting a request does not change a record automatically.
help.q9: Is there a fee to use TMistan?
help.a9: No. Searching records, opening record pages and downloading record reports on TMistan are currently free of charge, and no account is needed.
help.a10: Use the Contact page to send us a message. Where an e-mail address or telephone number is published in the Contact Support panel on this page, you can also reach us directly.
help.q11: What is the Official Gazette and how do I find it?
help.a11: The Official Gazette of Afghanistan is the publication in which trademark applications are published. Every TMistan record is taken from an issue of the gazette and shows its source as the gazette number and page, for example “OG 1011 — Page 3”. The Data Sources & Methodology page lists the issues covered.
help.a12: Trademark classes are the 45 categories of the Nice Classification: classes 1–34 cover goods and classes 35–45 cover services. The class shown on a record is the class in which the application was published. The Knowledge Center article “Understanding Trademark Classes” explains them in more detail.

g.class: Class — one of the 45 Nice Classification categories of goods (1–34) and services (35–45).
g.gazette: Gazette — an issue of the Official Gazette in which trademark applications are published.
g.objection: Objection deadline — the last date on which a third party may oppose the application.
g.applicant: Applicant — the person or company that filed the trademark application.

terms.short: Rules for accessing and using TMistan, including acceptable use and prohibited activities.
intro: **Welcome to TMistan.** These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the TMistan platform, including all content, features and services provided through the website.
By accessing or using TMistan, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the platform.

sections.title: About TMistan
sections.text: TMistan is an independent research platform operated by Masnad Law Firm. It provides a searchable way to explore trademark records published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan and is designed to help lawyers, businesses, entrepreneurs and researchers find and review trademark information more easily. TMistan is not a government authority or an official registry, and the records it displays do not replace the official publication.

sections.title: Use of the Platform
sections.text: You may use TMistan for informational and research purposes only. By accessing or using the platform, you agree to:
items: Use the platform in a lawful and responsible manner.
Respect the rights of others and comply with applicable laws and regulations.
Provide truthful and accurate information when submitting forms or requests.
Avoid misuse, interference, or attempts to gain unauthorized access.
Not submit malicious files, automated traffic, or content that may harm the platform or other users.

sections.title: Prohibited Activities
sections.text: You must not use TMistan to:
items: Attempt to access areas of the platform without authorization.
Interfere with the platform's operation or security.
Submit false, misleading, or inaccurate information.
Upload harmful, illegal, or copyrighted content without permission.
Engage in any activity that could damage the platform or its users.
Copy or download the database systematically by automated means without written permission.
Present a search result or record as an official certificate, clearance or legal determination.

sections.title: Nature of the Information
sections.text: Records are transcribed from published sources and displayed as they are available to us. A search result, record, image or publication reference does not by itself establish the registration, ownership, validity, enforceability or current status of a trademark. A value that is missing from a record is shown as N/A and does not mean that the information does not exist elsewhere. Please read the Disclaimer and the Data Sources & Methodology page.

sections.title: Submissions and Correction Requests
sections.text: Messages sent through the Contact page and requests sent through the Data Correction & Verification page are requests for review. They do not automatically change a record and do not guarantee a correction, a response time or a particular outcome. Reviews are carried out against the available source material and are documented internally.

sections.title: Third-Party Content and Links
sections.text: Trademarks, logos, names and Gazette material shown on the platform belong to their respective rights holders and are displayed for information and research. Links to external websites are provided for convenience; TMistan does not control those websites and does not endorse their content.

sections.title: Availability and Changes
sections.text: TMistan may be interrupted for maintenance or technical reasons and may change its features, content and these Terms. Material changes are published on this page together with the revision date.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.text: The TMistan name, logo, interface and original written content are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. The Intellectual Property policy explains what you may do with the content and how to raise a rights concern.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.short: Learn what personal data is collected and how it is handled and protected.
intro: This policy describes what information TMistan processes when you browse the website and when you submit a form, who can see it and how long it is kept. It is written to match how the platform actually works.
TMistan is operated by Masnad Law Firm, Kabul, Afghanistan.

sections.title: Browsing without an account
sections.text: The public pages do not require registration. The website does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Your language choice is stored in your own browser (local storage) so that the interface opens in the same language next time; it is not sent to us.

sections.title: Hosting and technical logs
sections.text: The website is served by Render and the database and file storage are provided by Supabase. Like any hosting provider, these services keep technical logs of requests (IP address, time, requested page, browser type) for security and operation. We do not combine those logs with form submissions.

sections.title: Information you submit
sections.text: When you use the Contact page or the Data Correction & Verification page we store what you type: your name, e-mail address, organisation (optional), subject, message and the record details you provide, together with the interface language, the page from which you sent the form, your browser type and a one-way hash of your IP address. The IP address itself is not stored; the hash only lets us limit abuse. Files attached to a correction request are stored in private storage that is not publicly accessible.

sections.title: Searches and image search
sections.text: Keyword searches are processed by the database and are not linked to you. For image search, a compact numeric description of the picture is computed in your browser and compared with the index; the picture itself is not uploaded or stored.

sections.title: Why we process this information
items: To answer your inquiry or research request.
To review a reported discrepancy against the source material and record the outcome.
To keep the platform secure and prevent abuse (rate limiting, spam filtering).
To improve the reliability of the records we display.

sections.title: Who can access it
sections.text: Submissions are visible only to authorised administrators of Masnad Law Firm through a protected administration area. They are not public and cannot be read through the website's data interface. Administrators sign in with an e-mail address and password; a session token is stored in the administrator's browser.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.text: We do not sell personal data. Data is processed on our behalf by the hosting providers named above. We may disclose information where the law requires it.

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: Submissions are kept for as long as they are needed to handle the request and to keep a record of how a data correction was decided. You may ask us to delete a submission; we may keep a minimal record of a completed correction so that the history of a record stays traceable.

sections.title: Your requests
sections.text: To ask what information we hold about you, to correct it or to have it deleted, use the Contact page (General Inquiry) and quote the reference you received when you submitted the form.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: Access to the database is restricted by role-based permissions and row-level security, and submissions are written only through validated server functions. No system is perfectly secure, so please do not send passwords, payment details or unnecessary sensitive information.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: Updates are published on this page together with the revision date.

privacy.note: A dedicated privacy contact (e-mail address or postal address) is to be supplied by Masnad Law Firm. Until then, requests are received through the Contact page.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.short: Understand the limits of information on the platform and the nature of search results.
intro: TMistan is a platform for searching and exploring trademark records published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan.

sections.title: Informational purpose
sections.text: The information displayed on this platform is provided for general informational and research purposes. Although reasonable care may be taken to organize, display, and maintain the available records, TMistan does not guarantee that all information is complete, accurate, current, or free from errors or omissions.

sections.title: What a record does not prove
sections.text: A search result, database entry, image, publication reference, or other record displayed by TMistan should not, by itself, be treated as conclusive proof of trademark registration, ownership, validity, enforceability, or current legal status.

sections.title: Consult the source and a professional
sections.text: Where a decision depends on a trademark record, users should consult the relevant Official Gazette and appropriate authoritative sources. Users requiring a legal determination or advice concerning a particular trademark should consult a qualified professional.

sections.title: Not a government authority
sections.text: TMistan is an information and research platform. Unless expressly established and authorized otherwise, it should not be represented as a government authority, official registry, or substitute for an official record or legal determination.

sections.title: No legal advice
sections.text: Nothing on this platform constitutes legal advice or creates a lawyer-client relationship.

ip.short: Learn about ownership, attribution, reuse and rights concerns.
intro: This policy explains who owns the different materials you see on TMistan, what you may do with them and how a rights holder can raise a concern.

sections.title: TMistan materials
sections.text: The TMistan name and logo, the design of the interface, the original explanatory texts (including the Knowledge Center articles) and the software that runs the platform belong to Masnad Law Firm or its licensors and are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws.

sections.title: Third-party material
sections.text: Trademarks, logos, brand names, applicant names and the content of Gazette publications shown on the platform belong to their respective rights holders. Displaying a record does not mean that TMistan owns the mark or the artwork, and it does not imply any relationship between TMistan and the rights holder.

sections.title: Source publications
sections.text: Gazette material is reproduced for reference and research. The printed Official Gazette of Afghanistan remains the authoritative publication; where a record and the publication differ, the publication prevails.

sections.title: What you may do
items: View and search the records and read the articles for your own research.
Print or download a record report for personal, educational or professional reference, keeping the disclaimer it contains.
Quote short extracts with the attribution “Source: Official Gazette of Afghanistan, via TMistan”.
sections.after: Systematic copying, bulk downloading, scraping or commercial redistribution of the database, the images or the articles requires written permission from Masnad Law Firm.

sections.title: Raising a rights concern
sections.text: If you believe that material displayed on TMistan infringes your rights or is attributed incorrectly, send a request through the Contact page (General Inquiry) with the serial number of the record, your relationship to the rights concerned and what you ask us to do. Every request is reviewed; we may contact you for evidence and may limit the display of an item while the review is ongoing. Content is not removed automatically because a claim was made.

sections.text: TMistan is a brand of Masnad Law Firm. All other names, marks and logos are the property of their respective owners.

dataSources.metaDescription: Where TMistan's trademark records come from, how they are organized, how Gazette and page references work, and the limitations to consider when researching.
dataSources.title: Data Sources & Methodology
dataSources.intro1: TMistan provides a searchable way to explore trademark records published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan. This page explains the origin of the available records, the role of source references, and the limitations users should consider when conducting research.
dataSources.intro2: Our aim is to make published trademark information easier to find and review while helping users understand the distinction between a published record and an independently confirmed current legal status.

gazette.title: Official Gazette of Afghanistan
gazette.p1: The trademark records available through TMistan are derived from the Official Gazette of Afghanistan and the source materials collected and processed for inclusion in the platform.
gazette.p2: Where available, each record includes references such as its Gazette number and source page, helping users identify the relevant publication and locate the original information.
gazette.p3: Users should consult the underlying publication when they need to verify a particular entry or make an important legal or business decision.
gazette.flowTitle: From Official Gazette to Searchable Result
gazette.notOfficial: TMistan is an independent research platform operated by Masnad Law Firm. It is not a government registry and not an official government service.

fields.title: How Trademark Records Are Organized
fields.lead: Each record in TMistan includes the following information, where available in the source data:

mark.title: Mark Name
mark.text: The trademark name or wording recorded in the available source.

serial.title: Serial Number
serial.text: The identifier used to locate a trademark record within TMistan.

applicant.title: Applicant
applicant.text: The applicant name recorded in the source, where available.

class.title: Class
class.text: The trademark class associated with the record, where available.

goods.title: Goods and Services
goods.text: The description recorded for the relevant goods or services, where available.

gazette.title: Gazette Number
gazette.text: The Gazette issue associated with the record.

date.title: Publication Date
date.text: The date recorded for the publication, where available.

page.title: Source Page
page.text: The page reference used to locate the entry in the underlying source.

other.title: Other Record Details
other.text: Application, registration, ownership, address, or deadline information where present in the source data.

fields.note: Not every record contains all of these fields. A value that is not present in the source is shown as N/A.

quality.title: Data Processing & Quality Control
quality.p1: To make historical trademark information easier to search, source materials are organized into structured digital records. The information displayed depends on the availability and quality of the underlying material.
quality.p2: Record fields and trademark images may require review where the source is incomplete, unclear, or difficult to interpret. TMistan aims to present the available information in a clear and useful format while preserving source references where available.
quality.p3: If you identify a missing field, an apparent data discrepancy, or an image that appears to be associated with the wrong record, please contact us and provide the relevant record details.
approach: Organize source materials into structured digital records
Preserve source references (Gazette number, page) with every record
Flag records and images that need review in the administration tools
Associate trademark images with records by serial number
Act on user reports of missing or incorrect information

images.title: Trademark Images & Record Matching
images.p1: Images are displayed according to the image files and record associations available in the platform.
images.p2: Where the import process matches an image filename to a trademark serial number, this is a data-association mechanism, not independent confirmation that the image is authentic or legally registered.
images.p3: If you notice a missing image, an incorrect image, or a suspected mismatch between an image and its record, please report it through the Contact & Feedback page with the relevant details.
images.callout: Image-to-serial matching is a data-association process, not a legal verification of authenticity or registration status.

coverage.title: Understanding the Available Information
coverage.p1: TMistan displays the trademark records currently available in its database. The extent of coverage depends on the source materials collected, processed, and included in the platform.
coverage.p2: Some records may have incomplete or unavailable fields. A missing field does not necessarily mean that the information does not exist in another source.
coverage.p3: Historical publication information should not, by itself, be treated as confirmation of a trademark's current registration status, ownership, validity, enforceability, or legal availability.
points: Coverage depends on the source material available.
Missing information should not be interpreted as a definitive legal conclusion.
Important decisions should be supported by appropriate source review and professional advice.

disclaimer.title: Important Information
disclaimer.text: TMistan is an informational research platform. The records displayed are provided to help users explore trademark publications and are not a substitute for official confirmation, current-status verification, or legal advice. Users should consult the relevant source material and obtain appropriate professional advice before relying on information for legal or commercial decisions.
disclaimer.reportNote: Downloadable Trademark Publication Reports carry the full approved disclaimer, reproduced here for reference.

services.metaDescription: Inquire about tailored trademark research through Masnad Law Firm: availability research, similar-mark research, historical Gazette research, record review, portfolio research and customized reports.
services.title: Trademark Research & Professional Assistance
services.intro1: TMistan provides access to available trademark publication records in Afghanistan. For users who require more focused research, additional review, or assistance understanding relevant records, Masnad Law Firm may be able to provide tailored professional support.
services.intro2: Contact us to describe your research needs and learn whether an appropriate service is available.

fromSearch.title: From Record Search to Focused Research
fromSearch.p1: Finding a published trademark record is often only the first step. Depending on the circumstances, a user may need to compare similar marks, examine historical publications, review applicant information, or organize findings into a report.
fromSearch.p2: TMistan helps users begin that process by making available published records easier to search. For more specific needs, users can contact Masnad Law Firm to discuss the scope of their inquiry.

cards.title: Services You Can Inquire About
cards.lead: Availability, scope, timeline and any fees are confirmed by Masnad Law Firm for each inquiry. None of these services is automated or included in the free search.

availability.title: Trademark Availability Research
availability.text: Preliminary research to identify potentially relevant trademark records in the available sources and explore whether similar or identical marks appear in the records reviewed.
availability.deliverable: A summary of relevant records identified during the agreed research scope.
availability.note: This research does not guarantee that a mark is legally available or that an application will succeed.

similar.title: Similar Trademark Research
similar.text: Focused research to identify potentially similar names, wording, or trademark images within the available records.
similar.deliverable: A list of potentially relevant records and their available source references.
similar.note: Visual or textual similarity results are research leads and are not a definitive legal assessment.

historical.title: Historical Trademark Research
historical.text: Research into trademark records published in available historical Gazette materials, where the relevant sources and records are available.
historical.deliverable: A summary of relevant historical entries, including Gazette and page references where available.
historical.note: Comprehensive coverage of every historical Gazette issue cannot be promised.

review.title: Trademark Record Review
review.text: Assistance reviewing available information associated with selected trademark records, such as applicant names, classifications, publication details, and source references.
review.deliverable: An organized review of the selected records and any limitations identified.
review.note: A database entry alone does not prove current ownership or legal status.

portfolio.title: Trademark Portfolio Research
portfolio.text: Research support for businesses or professionals seeking to identify and organize trademark records relevant to selected applicants, brands, or classes.
portfolio.deliverable: An organized record list or research summary, subject to the available data and agreed scope.
portfolio.note: Complete portfolio identification cannot be promised without verifying coverage.

custom.title: Customized Trademark Research Report
custom.text: For inquiries requiring a tailored scope, users can request a discussion about a customized trademark research report based on available records and any additional research agreed with Masnad Law Firm.
custom.deliverable: A report defined by the agreed scope, source availability, and professional engagement.
custom.note: Content, timeline, and fees must be confirmed by the firm.

steps.title: Describe Your Needs
steps.text: Tell us whether you need research on a particular brand, applicant, serial number, class, or group of records.

steps.title: Initial Review
steps.text: The team reviews the inquiry to understand the requested scope and determine whether the available information is suitable.

steps.title: Confirm Scope
steps.text: If the firm can assist, it confirms the proposed work, deliverables, timeline, and any applicable fees before work begins.

steps.title: Research and Delivery
steps.text: Research is conducted according to the agreed scope, and the resulting deliverable is provided through the agreed communication method.

process.note: Response and delivery times depend on the scope of the request and are confirmed by the firm for each engagement.

audience.title: Who May Benefit
items: Businesses researching brands before making commercial decisions.
Legal professionals conducting preliminary record research.
Trademark professionals organizing available publication information.
Researchers studying historical trademark publications.
Organizations reviewing records associated with selected names or applicants.
audience.note: TMistan and these services are not suited to every legal or regulatory situation; the firm will say so when a request falls outside what it can support.

info.title: What Information Should You Provide?
items: Trademark or brand name.
Known serial number.
Applicant or owner name as shown in the source.
Relevant class, if known.
Gazette number or source page, if known.
Type of research requested.
Purpose and geographic scope of the inquiry.
Desired deliverable and any relevant deadline.
info.warning: Please do not submit passwords, payment-card details, or unnecessary sensitive information through the inquiry form.

limits.title: Scope & Limitations
limits.p1: Research results depend on the information available and the scope of the work agreed. Similarity searches and historical record reviews may identify relevant information but cannot guarantee that all potentially relevant marks have been located.
limits.p2: A publication record does not, by itself, establish current registration status, ownership, validity, enforceability, or legal availability. Any professional assessment and associated advice must be confirmed separately with Masnad Law Firm.
limits.note: A free database search on TMistan is not a formal legal opinion.

items.q: Is basic searching on TMistan free?
items.a: Yes. Searching the trademark publication records available on TMistan is free of charge. Fees, where they apply, concern only professional services confirmed by Masnad Law Firm before any work begins.

items.q: Can you search for similar trademarks?
items.a: You can submit an inquiry about similarity research. The team confirms whether the requested scope can be supported by the available records and tools.

items.q: Can you guarantee that a trademark is available?
items.a: No. A search cannot guarantee legal availability or the outcome of an application.

items.q: How much does a customized report cost?
items.a: Fees, if applicable, depend on the scope of work and must be confirmed by Masnad Law Firm before engagement.
The timeline depends on the scope and availability of source material. A timeframe should be confirmed with the firm.

classification.text: Wrong or missing trademark class or goods and services details.

image.title: Image Problems
image.text: Missing image, incorrect image, or suspected mismatch with the record.

publication_reference.title: Publication Reference
publication_reference.text: Incorrect Gazette number, publication date, or source page information.

duplicate.title: Duplicate Records
duplicate.text: Possible duplicate entries or related record issues.

other.title: Other Discrepancies
other.text: Any other issue you believe needs attention.

form.label: Submit a request
form.title: Data Correction Request Form
form.text: Please provide as much detail as possible. The more information you share, the easier it will be for us to review your request.
form.record: Related Record (Serial Number or Gazette No.)
form.recordHint: The serial number is shown on every record page (issue–position, e.g. 1022-073).
form.detailsPlaceholder: Please describe the issue in detail. Include any relevant information, such as the record number, page reference, or what you believe is incorrect.
form.attachText: You can upload relevant files such as images, documents, or screenshots.
form.confirm: I confirm that the information provided is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.
form.privacy: Your name and e-mail address are used only to review this request and to contact you if we need more information. See the <1>Privacy Policy</1>.

errors.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
errors.confirm: Please confirm that the information is accurate.
errors.fileType: {{name}}: only JPG, PNG or PDF files can be attached.
errors.fileSize: {{name}}: files must be smaller than {{mb}} MB.
errors.fileCount: You can attach at most {{count}} files.

status.unavailableTitle: The request form is not available yet
status.unavailableText: The correction request form is temporarily unavailable while the platform's database is being updated. Please try again later, or report the issue through the Contact page.
status.successText: Thank you. Your request has been stored and will be reviewed against the source materials. Keep your reference number: together with your e-mail address it lets you check the status of the request on this page at any time.
status.uploadFailedHint: The request itself was stored. If the file matters, mention it when we contact you, or submit a new request with the file attached.
status.failedTitle: Your request could not be submitted
status.failedText: We could not submit your request at this time. Please try again. If the problem continues, use the Contact page.
status.rateLimited: Too many requests were sent from this address in a short time. Please wait a while before trying again.

check.label: Already submitted a request?
check.title: Check the Status of a Request
check.text: Enter the reference number you received together with the e-mail address you used. Only that combination returns a result.
check.noMatch: No request matches this reference number and e-mail address.
check.failed: The status could not be checked right now. Please try again.

statusText.received: Your request has been stored and is waiting for review.
statusText.under_review: The request is being compared with the source materials.
statusText.more_info_needed: We need more information to continue. Please see the note below and contact us with the details.
statusText.resolved: The review is complete and the information displayed on TMistan was updated where appropriate.
statusText.closed_no_change: The review is complete. The displayed information matches the source materials, so no change was made.

process.title: Our Review Process
process.text: Your request will be reviewed by our team against the original source materials. We may contact you for additional information if needed.

receive.title: Receive your request
receive.text: We confirm that your submission is complete and give you a reference number.

review.title: Review and verify
review.text: We compare with source documents and records.

update.title: Update the record
update.text: If the issue is valid, we update the information in TMistan.

outcome.title: Check the outcome
outcome.text: Use your reference number and e-mail address on this page to see the status and the outcome. We may also contact you by e-mail if we need more information.

important.title: Important
important.text: Please note that TMistan does not directly modify official government records. We only update the information displayed on our platform based on verified source materials.

help.title: Need Help?
help.text: If you have questions about this process or need assistance, please visit our Help page or contact us.

closing.label: Our commitment
closing.title: More Accurate Records. A Stronger Research Community.
closing.text: Your feedback helps us improve the quality and reliability of TMistan. Together, we can make trademark information in Afghanistan easier to find, verify, and trust.
